body.value: Yamabushi (mountain ascetics of the Shugendō tradition) = 6 persons. One of six occupational/religious categories itemised here under the 内 ('of which') breakdown of Yūki's commoner population, a list that begins on the facing right page (p067R) with 神主 13 and 社人 3.
Buddhist monks = 128 persons — by far the largest of the religious/occupational categories on this page. Printed in the lower register of the same column as 山伏.
Shugen (a licensed Shugendō practitioner) = 1 person — the smallest category recorded in Yūki's 内 breakdown.
Physicians = 10 persons. The value is a plain 十 (simple cross), not 千 — 10, not 1,000.
Zatō (members of the blind men's guild — masseurs, musicians, moneylenders) = 4 persons.
Dōshin (lay Buddhist devotees / unordained novices attached to temples) = 8 persons. The value is 八 (splayed strokes, separate at the apex), not 六.

Structural marker: 'besides / in addition'. Printed one glyph-step lower than the field labels, it closes the 内 ('of which') list of groups counted INSIDE the commoner population and opens the registers counted OUTSIDE it — the 鉦打 and 穢多 households that follow to its left. MASTER folds this glyph into its field label as '外 鉦打戸數'; it is boxed separately here because it scopes both following registers, not just one.
鉦打戸數 四軒 人員 六人 内 男四人 女二人
鉦打戸数（かねうちこすう）4軒、人員（じんいん）6人 — 内 男4人・女2人

Kane-uchi (鉦打, itinerant gong-beating mendicants — a marginal/outcaste occupational group) households = 4, persons = 6. The 内 split gives 男 4 + 女 2 = 6, internally consistent ✓. Recorded under the 外 marker, i.e. outside the commoner household and population totals carried over from p067R. Yūki's smallest register on this page.
Of the kane-uchi population: male = 4. Right-hand run of the warichu split beneath 六人.
Of the kane-uchi population: female = 2. (4 + 2 = 6 ✓, matching the printed 六人 total above.)
穢多戸數 六十軒 人員 貳百七十八人 内 男百四十六人 女百三十貳人
穢多戸数（えたこすう）60軒、人員（じんいん）278人 — 内 男146人・女132人

Eta (穢多, hereditary outcaste) households = 60, persons = 278 (男 146 + 女 132 = 278 ✓) — about 4.6 persons per household, the larger of the two registers recorded under 外. MASTER ERROR: MASTER assigns this 278-person figure and its M/F split to 士卒戸數 instead, and gives 穢多戸數 the value '六十軒 人員百三十三人 士族' — the '百三十三人 士族' is actually 百三十三軒 士族, a household count printed four columns to the left in the 士卒 breakdown. On the scan 人員 貳百七十八人 sits unambiguously in this column (x 1881–2006).
Of the eta population: male = 146. Right-hand run of the warichu split beneath 貳百七十八人.
Of the eta population: female = 132. (146 + 132 = 278 ✓, matching the printed total above.)
士卒戸數 貳百三拾壹軒
士卒戸数（しそつこすう）231軒

Shi-sotsu (samurai + lower-retainer) households = 231, written with the formal numerals 貳百三拾壹 (拾 carries the 扌 hand radical; 壹 is the formal 1). The 内 breakdown immediately to the left itemises them as 133 shizoku + 74 sotsu + 24 under house-arrest = 231 ✓. MASTER ERROR: MASTER appends '人員 貳百七十八人 内男百四十六人女百三十貳人' to this field — that population belongs to 穢多戸數, the column to the RIGHT. This column prints the household count only and is blank below y≈1882.

Of the 231 shi-sotsu households, 133 are shizoku (former samurai). The count is printed in the upper register with its category label 士族 below it in the lower register of the same column — the value-above / label-below convention used throughout this page. MASTER has no row for this figure; it instead appears, garbled, inside MASTER's 穢多戸數 and 謹愼ノ者 value strings.
Of the 231 shi-sotsu households, 74 are sotsu (lower retainers / foot-soldiers, the sub-samurai stratum created by the 1869–70 status reform). Leading glyph verified as 七, not 九.
貳十四軒 謹愼ノ者
24軒 — 謹慎ノ者（きんしんのもの）

Of the 231 shi-sotsu households, 24 are 謹愼ノ者 — households under kinshin (house-arrest / confinement), the penalty imposed on retainers in the aftermath of the Boshin War. 133 + 74 + 24 = 231 ✓, closing the 内 breakdown exactly. That a domain recorded confined retainers as a standing household category in the 1870 survey is itself notable.

Persons in the 231 shi-sotsu households = 950 (≈4.1 per household). The status lines that break this total down reconcile exactly: 士族妻子 613 (男 289 + 女 324, printed on this page) + 卒族同斷 256 (男 144 + 女 112) + 謹愼同斷 81 (男 40 + 女 41) = 950 ✓. The latter two print on p068R to the right of the ○湯長谷藩 marker and therefore still belong to Yūki. MASTER ERROR: MASTER conflates this entry with the 士族妻子 pair into a single row, '人員 (士族妻子) = 九百五十人 男貳百八拾九人 女三百貳十四人'. They are two distinct entries a full column apart — 289 + 324 = 613, not 950 — and the M/F pair carries no 内 marker, so it is not a split of this total.

Shizoku wives and children — male = 289. Right-hand run of the warichu pair. Verified glyph-by-glyph: 貳 / 百 / 八 (splayed, no top lid — not 六) / 十 (plain cross — not 千) / 九 (crossing stroke with hooked leg — not 七 or 八).

Shizoku wives and children — female = 324. Left-hand run of the warichu pair; its rightmost ink touches the male run's leftmost ink at x=1020, so the two boxes share that flush boundary. (289 + 324 = 613.)
男 貳百八十九人 女 三百二十四人 士族妻子
男 289人・女 324人 — 士族妻子（しぞくさいし）

Shizoku wives and children = 289 male + 324 female = 613 persons, the largest status component of the 950 shi-sotsu population. The category label 士族妻子 is printed BELOW its two figures (the value-above / label-below convention of this page); the box covers the label, with the two figures boxed separately above. Note this is NOT an 内-split of the 950 total: it starts higher on the page (y1139 vs y1225), sits a full column to the left, and carries no 内 marker. Yūki's status split continues on p068R with 卒族同斷 (男 144 / 女 112 = 256) and 謹愼同斷 (男 40 / 女 41 = 81), which print in the identical shape to the right of the ○湯長谷藩 marker and therefore still belong to Yūki. The three lines close the register exactly: 613 + 256 + 81 = 950.
藩制一覧表（はんせいいちらんひょう）第七（結城）

Running header / provenance, printed down the outer (left) margin: 'Hansei Ichiran-hyō, Fascicle 7 (Yūki).' Fascicle 7 belongs to the civil/economic register carried in volume 2 (lower). This is provenance, not data — on some pages the header names a different domain than the content, but here it agrees with the data, and the facing right page carries the same header. The 覧/覽 glyph is over-inked at this header type size and could not be resolved on this page; 覧 follows the convention used by every other header in the viewer.
Printed book-page number in the bottom margin: 111. Consistent with the facing right page (百十 = 110) and the next right page (百十二 = 112), confirming this as the left half of the spread.
